scope: Read-only final-source dependency analysis; full build still running at analysis time; no Lean/Lake invocation or repository edits by reviewer.

counting_caution: Consolidation means baseline vs final file counts do not measure the same proof-unit population. Represented baseline units use composed grouping destination, while split native source paths count as retained compatibility wrappers.
